public:
    static const int SIZE = 2000;
    int cnt, L[SIZE], R[SIZE];
    int seen[SIZE];

    int gao(int N, vector<int> e[]) {
        cnt = 0;
        memset(L, 255, sizeof(L));
        memset(R, 255, sizeof(R));
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            memset(seen, 0, sizeof(seen));
            if (match(i, e)) cnt++;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

private:
    bool match(int x, vector<int> e[]) {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)e[x].size(); i++) {
            int y = e[x][i];
            if (seen[y]) continue;
            seen[y] = 1;
            if (R[y] < 0 || match(R[y], e)) {
                L[x] = y;
                R[y] = x;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

void bfsFromStart(int r, int c) {
    queue<int> qr, qc;
    memset(D, 255, sizeof(D));
    qr.push(r);
    qc.push(c);
    D[r][c] = 0;
    while (!qr.empty()) {
        r = qr.front(); qr.pop();
        c = qc.front(); qc.pop();
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {

                qc.push(nc);

    vis[r0][c0] = 0;

        int r = qr.front(); qr.pop();
        int c = qc.front(); qc.pop();

        for (int i = 0; i < (int)things[r][c].size(); i++)
            for (int k = 0; k < cnt; k++)
